description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayAgentChannel component, verifying its delivery logic, correct normalization of raw input strings, and fallback behavior for unknown values.

classes.name: GatewayAgentChannelTests
classes.description: A struct containing test cases for GatewayAgentChannel's delivery logic and normalization behavior.

methods.name: `should deliver blocks web chat`
methods.description: Tests whether the webchat channel correctly does not deliver when expected.

methods.description: Checks that last, WhatsApp, Telegram, Google Chat, and Blue Bubbles channels deliver as expected.

methods.name: `init raw normalizes and falls back to last`
methods.description: Verifies that raw input strings are normalized to channel enums or fallback to last when unknown or null.
